contract_review.owner: Nested jwt/account.rs reuses existing JwtIssuer/JwtVerifier key and settings fields. Exports only frozen Account inputs/claims/outcome/assurance/token wrapper; no duplicate crypto owner or service.
contract_review.signed_typed_parse: jsonwebtoken::decode<T> receives AccountAccessClaims or AccountCsrfClaims directly. Both deny_unknown_fields, all fields required, no flatten/Value roundtrip or insecure decode. Derived duplicate guards remain active for every required field including identical repetitions.
contract_review.wire_grammar: Access exact12 fields and CSRF exact9. String canonical UUID parser rejects nil, uppercase/compact/braced/noncanonical forms without unnecessary version restriction. Generation requires canonical positive decimal STRING bounded by i64; numeric/zero/sign/leadingzero/overflow rejected. Assurance explicitly deserializes String then requires PASSKEY_PRIMARY, avoiding unit-enum object acceptance.
contract_review.crypto_protocol: Validation::new(ES256) preserves enabled signature and audience validation. Configured issuer exact/nonempty and distinct hardcoded audiences/kinds. Typed String issuer/audience rejects array alternatives. Pinned dependency verifies signature before signed typed parsing and standard issuer/audience validation.
contract_review.expiry_order: Both methods decode all cryptographic/closed-schema/identity/generation claims first, then exact kind and access auth_time, then every causal/nonnegative/non-expiry time rule. Only afterward access exp>trusted now is Current, exp<=now is Expired; valid expired proof yields fixed ExpiredSignature. Invalid expired inputs cannot reach an expiry success/fallback variant.
contract_review.trusted_time: validate_exp=false and validate_nbf=false plus leeway0 disable dependency internal wall-clock branch; pinned validation source confirms it calls wall clock only if either flag enabled. Local validation exclusively uses explicit trusted now; requires iat/nbf/exp>=0,iat/nbf<=now,exp>iat,nbf<=exp,checked span<=900/300 and access0<=auth_time<=iat.
contract_review.issuance_arithmetic: Access configured TTL must be positive; CSRF uses fixed300seconds. Nonnegative issuance, nonnil identity, positive generation, family ceiling after issuance required. lifetime=min(configuredTTL,protocolmax,familyremaining) precedes checked datetime addition, so large TTL and near-maximum date with short valid ceiling cannot overflow prematurely. Truncated wire timestamps must still give exp>iat. nbf=iat; access fresh UUIDv4 jti.
contract_review.fixed_errors: Every library decode error discarded into fixed AuthError::Jwt(InvalidToken). Token-derived local failures use same fixed error. Otherwise valid expired proof alone uses fixed ExpiredSignature. Trusted config/issuance/sign failures use static InvalidStoredData messages; raw serde/JWT/SQL/input diagnostics never retained or formatted by these new APIs.
contract_review.debug: SignedAccountToken private String has explicit as_str only, no Serialize/Display, fixed redacted Debug. Claim Debug methods write constant redacted names. Outcome derived Debug contains variant plus redacted claims only; input/assurance structs do not expose automatic input Debug. No tracing/printing of credentials or claims in module.
contract_review.authority_limit: Current and Expired remain cryptographic data. Caller must independently recheck ACTIVE/current generation/family protocol ownership/revocation/absolute lifetime and matching proof before expired-access fallback. No DB/session/Principal construction or primary-authentication proof inferred.
